title: FLX in the City - October Edition
description: Stretch, Breathe and Connect at FLX in the City, a Silent Rooftop Stretch experience of City Glow Yoga and The Teacher Chelsea
long_description:
Stretch, Breathe and Connect at FLX in the City, a Silent Rooftop Stretch experience of City Glow Yoga and The Teacher Chelsea

About this Event

STRETCH higher above the city with FLX in the CITY - a premium rooftop stretch and recovery experience by City Glow Yoga™, The Teacher Chelsea & Rock Events.
Join us on Sunday, October 18th from 7:30PM–9PM for the finale session of our monthly summer series centered around one simple rhythm: stretch, breathe, connect & repeat.
October Info:
Suggested Color: Pink
Music Vibe: Female Artists
FLX in the CITY™ blends luxury wellness, mindful movement, music, and social connection into an elevated rooftop experience designed to help you release tension, reset your energy, and recharge alongside the city skyline.
Start your evening by exploring the rooftop patio featuring wellness vendors, activations, and our signature Stretch Social + Recovery Lounge experience. Enjoy spectacular rooftop views and curated sounds by Musical Curator Kaels.
At 8:00 PM, The Teacher Chelsea will guide guests through a rejuvenating silent stretch session indoors on the rooftop focused on flexibility, mobility, recovery, breathwork, and mindfulness.
Whether you come solo, with friends, or as part of your wellness routine this summer, FLX in the CITY™ is your space to stretch, breathe, connect & repeat all season long.

Also check out other in Detroit, Health & Wellness events in Detroit.
